messages:
lina: creating RC-20260517 (artifact: inference-svc@4.2.1-rc1). tagging eng-releases for quiet window + ops custody. window: 2026-05-17 01:00-03:00 UTC. any blockers?
release-bot: RC created: RC-20260517 by lina. Pin: inference-svc@4.2.1-rc1. release notes draft: https://confluence/redwood/rc-20260517
deploy-bot: canary plan ready: 10% -> 30% -> 100%. abort rules: error-rate > 4% or p95 latency +50%.
sqa: kicking off smoke and regression harness now. will post results.
nick: KV prewarm queued (job kvwarm-2026-05-17). ETA ~5m. hooking perf traces.
ops-sheriff: I'll be watching the window. set pre-alert error-rate >2.5%
sqa: smoke mostly green but reg harness found a reranker 502 spike on some payloads (seen in test subset). opening ticket INF-1021.
lina: hmm. is reranker a hard dependency on the critical path?
nick: reranker used for final rerank step, fallback exists but default path can error if downstream times out.
ops-sheriff: recommend we hold at 10% until reranker team confirms stability.
lina: agree. hold at 10%. don't advance.
jamie: pinging reranker team. small config drift pushed yesterday might be the cause. I'll roll a quick patch and cut rc1.1 if needed.
release-bot: canary at 10% started (rollout r-1747654321-1).
(8m later)
sqa: reranker still spiking in canary traffic. error-rate on canary = 5.1% -> abort threshold hit.
ops-sheriff: abort. initiating rollback for RC-20260517.
deploy-bot: aborting rollout and rolling back to previous stable. `/deploy rollback RC-20260517` initiated by ops-sheriff.
release-bot: rollback complete. service back to stable artifact inference-svc@4.2.0. Rollback id rb-1747654321.
lina: thanks. jamie, please coordinate a hotfix. if fix is trivial we can cut rc2 in this thread.
jamie: root cause: routing config mismatch in reranker client. pushing hotfix branch now, will build a new rc artifact inference-svc@4.2.1-rc2 once CI finishes.
(CI + build)
release-bot: new RC created: RC-20260517-rc2 by jamie. Pin: inference-svc@4.2.1-rc2. notes updated: https://confluence/redwood/rc-20260517#rc2
lina: new plan: re-run KV warm, smoke, then canary 10->30->100. keep extended hold at 30 for 15m.
nick: re-running kvwarm job kvwarm-2026-05-17-2. ETA 6m.
sqa: rerunning regression harness against rc2, will focus specifically on reranker payloads.
deploy-bot: canary plan re-queued. abort rules unchanged.
(10m later)
sqa: rc2 smoke: reranker 502s gone in harness. smoke all green.
nick: perf traces look clean; no increased tail after hotfix.
ops-sheriff: pre-alert thresholds clear. I approve advancing to 30% with extended hold.
deploy-bot: promoting RC-20260517-rc2 to canary 10% -> started by lina. rollout r-1747654321-2.
release-bot: canary 10% metrics: error-rate +0.4%, p95 +8%.
deploy-bot: advancing to 30% with 15m hold. `/deploy promote RC-20260517-rc2 --pct 30 --hold 15m`
sqa: extended hold running. will run regression sweep at 5m and 12m.
nick: observing steady KV hit-rate. no cache churn. CPU/GPU normal.
sqa: regression sweep pass at 5m and 12m. no reranker regressions.
ops-sheriff: green. proceed with full promo when hold complete.
lina: prepping release notes (calling out reranker hotfix). @docs can you add a short blurb to the customer-facing notes?
docs: done and linked in the notes page.
deploy-bot: promoting to prod (100%). `/deploy promote RC-20260517-rc2 --to prod --pct 100` initiated by lina. rollout r-1747654321-final
release-bot: promotion started. streaming updates.
(7m into prod)
ops-sheriff: small transient error bump to 2.8% for ~90s, recovered. within guardrails. monitoring.
nick: investigated, caused by a single misbehaving reranker instance, removed from pool and auto-healed.
sqa: post-promo sanity checks green.
release-bot: telemetry snapshot: prod after 10m: error-rate +0.6%, p95 +12%. within thresholds.
lina: promotion complete. tagging RC-20260517-rc2 as promoted; please file any follow-ups to INF-1022. great job on quick hotfix and coordination.
ops-sheriff: handing off to normal oncall at 03:15 UTC. leaving note in ops-runbook.
release-bot: RC-20260517-rc2 promotion complete by lina. rollback command: `/deploy rollback RC-20260517-rc2` if needed.
jamie: thanks team. will monitor logs for next 24h and follow up in INF-1022.
lina: closing thread :white_check_mark:
